What can I do on CreatorHub?: What can I do on CreatorHub?
Browse published projects, discover crea: Browse published projects, discover creators and explore their services. Create an account to save work, follow creators and start private project conversations. CreatorHub does not handle payments or bookings.
How do I create an account?: How do I create an account?
Choose Sign up, enter your name, email o: Choose Sign up, enter your name, email or international phone number, and confirm your password. Email accounts need verification before protected actions. Phone signup does not currently verify ownership, and social sign-in is not available yet.
How do I become a creator?: How do I become a creator?
Use your workspace to create a creator p: Use your workspace to create a creator profile on your existing account. Add your headline, location, categories and skills, then submit it for administrator approval. You do not need a second account.
Add a project with its category, descrip: Add a project with its category, description, cover image and gallery. Submit it for administrator approval from your workspace. Pending edits keep the previous approved public version visible; rejected submissions show a reason.
What is the difference between a project: What is the difference between a project and a service?
A project showcases your portfolio work. A service describes work you offer, its deliverables and either a starting price in KRW or a custom quote. Service publication also requires approval.
Upload JPEG, PNG or WebP images and MP4: Upload JPEG, PNG or WebP images and MP4 or WebM gallery videos from the project editor. Each file must be 10 MB or smaller, with up to ten files per upload and twenty gallery items per project. Uploaded media is publicly accessible through its URL.
Open a creator profile or service and ch: Open a creator profile or service and choose Send inquiry. Describe your project, optionally select a service, budget or deadline, then send. You cannot inquire about your own work. The original brief appears directly in the conversation.
New inquiries and replies appear in your: New inquiries and replies appear in your Inbox and its unread badge. They do not appear in Notifications. Notifications is reserved for activity such as follows, project likes, comments and newly published work.
Only the client and the creator taking p: Only the client and the creator taking part in an inquiry can read its conversation. Administrator status alone does not grant access to private inquiries. Messages remain available in the conversation history.
How do likes, saved projects and follows: How do likes, saved projects and follows work?
Press the heart once to like a project a: Press the heart once to like a project and again to remove your like. Save projects to your private Saved list. Follow creators to keep up with their work, and use Followers & Following in your account menu to view your connections.
How can the AI assistant help?: How can the AI assistant help?
Open Ask CreatorHub AI for help finding: Open Ask CreatorHub AI for help finding public creators, projects and services or understanding website workflows. Guests can use it too. Answers may be incomplete, so check linked results and avoid sharing sensitive information. It cannot access private conversations or make account changes.
Can I change the chat theme or website l: Can I change the chat theme or website language?
Choose Light, Dark or System in Inbox or: Choose Light, Dark or System in Inbox or the AI assistant; the setting applies to both and is saved in your browser. Use the language selector for English, Korean or Uzbek. On mobile, language, Inbox and Notifications are in the avatar menu.
